propositions: A ticket directory with no CREATE/SNAPSHOT event causes the plan-relation reducer to fail, surfacing an INDETERMINATE verdict on plan reviews of unrelated tickets whose relation graph walks through the orphaned directory.
Empty ticket directories are invisible to git and persist in local clones, making them impossible to detect via git status or fix by pulling shared history.
The plan-relation reducer tolerates event-less directories by skipping them with a warning instead of failing the snapshot, allowing reviews of unrelated tickets to proceed.

The writer continues creating ticket directories before appending their first event; the reader-side tolerance is the primary fix because writer-side cleanup cannot cover process-death races and would be unsafe under concurrent write semantics.
